From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novahealth.com>; Jordan Reyes <jordan.reyes@novahealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T15:20:00-05:00
Subject: MAP draft and next steps (NovaHealth)

Hi Priya and Jordan —

Thanks again for the call today. Quick recap and next steps + a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (attached) to keep momentum. Please review and confirm ownership/dates or call out anything missing.

High-level MAP (draft v0.1):
- Discovery complete (customer) — Owner: NovaHealth (Priya) — Target: 2026-11-05 — Dependency: final list of integration endpoints
- Security questionnaire + evidence (customer + Redwood) — Owner: NovaHealth (Jordan) / Redwood (Marissa) — Target: 2026-11-12 — Dependency: infra diagram + access matrix
- Technical POC (Redwood) — Owner: Rafael Mendes — Target: 2026-11-19 — Dependency: test dataset and credentials
- Legal: SOW review and sign (mutual) — Owner: NovaHealth Legal / Redwood Legal — Target: 2026-11-26
- Target close / go-live approval — Target: 2026-11-30

Attachments: MAP_NovaHealth_v0.1.xlsx, SOW_Draft.pdf (stubbed).

Open items / asks for NovaHealth:
1) Can you confirm the security reviewer contact and any additional evidence they will require?
2) Will the test dataset and service account be available by 11/10?

Proposed checkpoints:
- 11/05: Discovery sign-off (15min)
- 11/12: Security checkpoint (30min)
- 11/19: POC demo (30min)

If anything looks off, flag here and I’ll update the MAP.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@novahealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>; Jordan Reyes <jordan.reyes@novahealth.com>
Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael_mendes@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T10:12:00-05:00
Subject: Re: MAP draft and next steps (NovaHealth)

Marissa — thanks for the recap and the MAP. Two quick updates from our side after syncing with security and product: 

1) Security has asked for an expanded evidence set (runtime logging screenshots, encryption key policy, and a stub audit log) before their formal review. That will add ~1 week to their intake.
2) Product has reprioritized the POC scope: they want to validate the end-to-end integration with one pilot clinic first (smaller dataset) rather than full dataset. That reduces engineering lift but will push the POC demo from 11/19 -> 12/01.

Given those two changes, our internal expectation is the close date will move. Can we reforecast to target close 2026-12-15 and update MAP milestones accordingly?

I attached a quick note from security listing the additional evidence. We can jump on a 30-min sync if helpful.

Thanks —
Priya Shah
Director, IT Security | NovaHealth
priya.shah@novahealth.com
--Attachment: NovaHealth_Security_Evidence_Reqs.docx (docx, 22KB)

Subject: Updated MAP (v0.2) — reforecast to 2026-12-15

Priya / Jordan —

Appreciate the heads up. I updated the MAP (v0.2 attached) to reflect the security evidence request and the narrowed POC scope. Key changes below: 

Updated MAP (v0.2):
- Discovery complete (customer) — Owner: NovaHealth (Priya) — Target: 2026-11-05 — Status: complete
- Security evidence & review (customer + Redwood) — Owner: NovaHealth Security (Jordan) / Redwood (Marissa) — Target: 2026-11-19 — Notes: added checklist of artifacts (infra diagram, kms policy, sample audit log)
- Technical POC (Redwood) — Owner: Rafael Mendes — Target: 2026-12-01 — Scope: pilot clinic, reduced dataset
- Legal: SOW review and sign — Owner: Legal teams — Target: 2026-12-08
- Target close / go-live approval — Target: 2026-12-15

Dependencies and risk notes:
- Security evidence is on the critical path; if the evidence delivery slides beyond 11/19 we should expect additional slip.
- POC scope reduction lowers engineering risk but delays broader validation for other clinics.

Next steps (from Redwood):
1) Rafael to schedule the POC kickoff by 11/10 and request test credentials from NovaHealth (assigned).
2) Marissa to circulate updated MAP and create the 11/12 security checkpoint invite.
3) Legal teams to start parallel SOW review; we’ll share a redline template this week.

Attachments: MAP_NovaHealth_v0.2.xlsx (updated). Also linking the HubSpot deal and the MAP folder: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DEAL-4583, https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3C_MAP_NovaHealth

Please confirm these dates and ownerships and I’ll lock the calendar invites.

Thanks —

Priya confirmed the reduced POC scope and the new target dates — POC now targeted for 12/01 and target close 12/15. Rafael — can you confirm you can run the pilot clinic integration with a smaller dataset?

Short answers are fine — we’ll thread that into the MAP and then I’ll send calendar invites.

Marissa
